run_starlette_inference_server: run a Starlette server that serves Hugging Face PEFT model inference via POST routes
create_pipeline_from_env: create a cached pipeline instance using TASK and MODEL_ID environment variables
configure_allowed_tasks: configure the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary to map task names to Pipeline classes
setup_startup_event: setup an async startup event that initializes logging and starts the idle check loop
reset_logging_config: reset the Python logging configuration to DEBUG level with timestamp format
